description:
- New SMS reminder: switch it on in a task's special features and Ping texts that task's notes (or its title when the notes are empty) to the number you choose, every time a reminder fires. Pick the number from your contacts or type it in.
- Settings now has one "Special task settings" page holding soft notifications, the priority window, location triggers and the new SMS options — the default country code (a leading 0 is replaced, e.g. +972) and the Send SMS permission.
